title: Diomedes meets Glaucus
intro: Hector heads for Troy. Diomedes asks whether his new opponent is human, recalling Lycurgus' punishment.

notes.text: ἐλελίζω, wheel / rally: 3pl aor pass; ἵστημι, stand: unaugmented 3pl root aor.
ἐναντίος + gen, facing / opposite; the Trojans turn to face their pursuers.
ὑποχωρέω, withdraw: 3pl aor; λήγω, cease: unaugmented 3pl aor + gen; φόνος, slaughter.
φημί, say / suppose: unaugmented 3pl impf; ἀστερόεις, starry: gen sg.
ἀλέξω, defend: fut ptc acc sg, purpose; κατέρχομαι epic 2aor inf, = κατελθεῖν. “A god had come down to help the Trojans.”
“So completely had they rallied”; ἐλελίζω, unaugmented 3pl aor pass, shorter -θεν for -θησαν.
κέλομαι reduplicated aor mid, called to; ἀΰω aor ptc, shouted; μακρόν adv., loudly.
High-spirited; famed afar; allies / auxiliaries (the non-Trojan contingents).
μιμνήσκομαι, remember: 2pl aor mid imperative + gen; θοῦρις, impetuous; ἀλκή, fighting strength.
“While I go”; βαίνω, epic 1sg root aor subj, = βῶ; προτί = πρός, towards.
εἶπον 1sg 2aor subj, coordinated with βείω; βουλευτής, counsellor: dat pl, with γέρουσιν.
δαίμων, god / divine power: dat pl; ἀράομαι, pray: aor mid inf, after “tell.”
ὑπισχνέομαι, promise: 2aor mid inf; ἑκατόμβη, large sacrificial offering, originally a hundred cattle.
Flashing-helmed; Hector's recurrent epithet (κόρυς + αἰόλος).
σφυρόν, ankle: acc pl; αὐχήν, neck: acc sg; δέρμα, hide (neut), with κελαινός, dark, subject of τύπτε.
ἄντυξ, rim; πύματος, outermost / last. Apposition to the shield's leather: rim strikes neck and ankles as Hector walks.
θέω, run: unaugmented 3sg impf, “ran around”; ὀμφαλόεις, bossed: gen fem sg with shield.
σύνειμι (εἶμι, go), come together: unaugmented 3dual impf. μέμονα perf ptc nom dual, eager.
εἶμι pres ptc nom dual; two champions closing on each other.
φέριστος, best / mightiest: voc sg; καταθνητός, mortal: gen pl. Formally courteous challenge.
ὁράω, see: 1sg perf act; “I have never seen you before.”
κυδιάνειρα, bringing glory to men: dat fem sg with μάχῃ; κῦδος + ἀνήρ.
προβαίνω, advance: 2sg perf act; “you have come far in front of everyone”; gen comparison / separation.
θάρσος, boldness: dat sg; μένω, await / face: 2sg aor. ὅ τε introduces explanation, “since you have faced my spear.”
δύστηνος, unfortunate: gen pl; “those who face me have unlucky parents,” a threat through anticipated bereavement.
ἀντιάω, meet / face: epic expanded 3pl pres; + dat μένει, my force.
κατά + gen, down from; ἔρχομαι epic 2sg perf act, = ἐλήλυθας.
μάχομαι 1sg pres opt + ἄν, “I would not fight”; ἐπουράνιος, heavenly.
Lycurgus, son of Dryas; δήν, long; “did not live long.” ἔριζεν: ἐρίζω impf, quarrel / contend.
μαίνομαι pres ptc gen sg with Dionysus; τιθήνη, nurse / foster-mother: acc pl.
σεύω, chase: unaugmented 3sg aor; ἠγάθεος, very holy; Νυσήϊον, Mount Nysa. Their flight continues.
